input.answer: If I go with Harel, I'd pick the "כספי (שקלי)" track. It shows 0% מניות and 0% מט"ח, and it says 4.25% over 3 years, so it looks closest to my deposit. But I'm not sure it's really as safe as a deposit, so before I sign anything I'll ask you, and maybe the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons (כל המוצרים 105, קופת גמל להשקעה 16, קרנות סל, קרנות מחקות...)
stuck.why: Too many buttons and products I don't know. It wasn't clear I was already in the right place until I saw the lighter button.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Most rows just say 'פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים', with no number. I didn't know if that means the track is new or something is missing. Only a few rows have a number.
I'm not sure if 4.25% is for each year or for all three years together. The heading says 'שנתית', but the number sits next to '3 שנים'.
Turquoise and yellow look alike to me on the black background. I read the small percent numbers next to them instead.

findings.what: A big table full of percents and many columns. It made me anxious; lines are long and I lost my place.
Most tracks show no return at all, only 'פחות מ־3 שנים'.

English letters and words I don't know as track names (S&P 500, עוקב מדד, סחיר)

The site name 'מקור' means nothing to me. I don't know who is behind it.
